def count_valid_multiples(X, A, B, allowed_digits):
    allowed_digits_set = set(allowed_digits)
    count = 0

    for num in range(A, B + 1):
        if all(digit in allowed_digits_set for digit in str(num)):
            if num % X == 0:
                count += 1

    return count

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    X = int(data[0])
    A = int(data[1])
    B = int(data[2])
    allowed_digits = data[3]
    
    result = count_valid_multiples(X, A, B, allowed_digits)
    print(result)
